questions.stem: Which of the following statements about erythropoietin is false?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following statements about erythropoietin is false?

options.label: A
options.text: It is used for the treatment of anaemia due to chronic renal failure.

options.label: B
options.text: It results in decrease in reticulocyte count.

options.label: C
options.text: It decreases the requirement of blood transfusions.
